data.name: Belvia
data.gender_notes: Belvia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Bélos' meaning beautiful and 'Via' meaning struggle or way. This name symbolizes the beauty in overcoming challenges and persevering through life's difficulties. The name Belvia carries the meaning “Beautiful Struggle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Belvia usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful struggle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the struggle with faith and grace.
data.etymology: Belvia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful Struggle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Belvia total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
